title: Measles cases reach 35-year high in US
snippet:
The sustained transmission reported in the United States in the last two years puts the country’s elimination status in jeopardy per the Pan American Health Organization and is a sign that many communities have vaccination rates much lower than the 95% coverage needed for herd immunity. 

> Reaching this milestone is particularly striking because we are only in July. [...] Last week, Utah officials published new data in a Public Health Alerts reportdescribing outcomes among measles patients. The state has been battling an outbreak for 12 months involving 711 cases in the past 12 months, 514 of them in 2026 alone. 

Only about 8% of patients in the current outbreak have been hospitalized, and of those, 90% were unvaccinated. Three of the five hospitalized patients who were vaccinated had "severe immunocompromising conditions.” [...] ### CDC: Ever-expanding US measles outbreak tops last year's total

title: Measles Cases Hit New Record in U.S., as Vaccination Rates Wane
snippet:
On Friday, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announced that there have been 2,318 confirmed cases of measles so far this year. The case count toppled the record set last year, when measles infected more than 2,200 Americans and killed two unvaccinated children. More measles cases have been reported in the United States in the last two years than in all the years from 2000 through 2024 combined. [...] Skip to contentSkip to site index

title: These seven states are hot spots for 2026's record measles outbreak
snippet:
In Utah, complications related to measles have ranged from pneumonia and dehydration to sepsis and shock, Axios' Erin Alberty writes.

## Texas

Texas had 803 cases in 2025 — more than any other state — but has seen far fewer this year, with the state reporting 188 in 2026.

   Vaccination rates for children have been dropping in Texas, just like the rest of the country.

## Virginia

Virginia had only six cases in 2025, but has now seen 176 in 2026. [...] The latest:As of late July, the CDC had recorded 2,318 cases for the year. The vast majority of those sickened are under 20 years old and are either unvaccinated or their status is unknown. There have been no recorded deaths.

   Measles was declared eliminated in the U.S. some 26 years ago, thanks to an effective vaccination program. 
   When more than 95% of people are vaccinated in a community, most people are protected — but vaccination coverage among kindergarteners has slipped. [...] Image 3: A map shows reported measles cases by state, as of July 26, 2026. South Carolina and Utah report the most, with 670 and 522 cases respectively. Five other states report more than 100 cases, seven states report none. All other states and Washington, D.C. reported less than 20 cases.

Data: CDC; Map: Sara Wise/Axios

Seven states account for the majority of measles cases in the United States, becoming hot spots for the life-threatening disease.
